answers.how: The car, including its extending wire, spans about 248 pixels; the tire diameter is about 48 pixels. Length = 248/48 × 0.369.
Tracking the same wheel across nearby frames gives approximately 520 pixels/s at 1 s. Converted using 0.369 m per 48 pixels.
A smooth local fit to the tracked positions gives approximately 65 pixels/s² at 1 s. Converted using the tire scale.
Tracking the wheel across nearby frames gives approximately 510 pixels/s at 1.5 s. Converted using 0.369 m per 48 pixels.
A smooth local fit gives a deceleration magnitude of approximately 210 pixels/s² at 1.5 s. Converted using the tire scale.
